# Phoenix

Phoenix uses a warm, high-contrast palette of reds, oranges, yellows, greys and blacks with subtle blue and green accents. Its recorded description recommends Live Preview and states that the dark theme receives the primary styling and updates.

![Phoenix screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryzenfromfire/obsidian-phoenix/HEAD/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Phoenix"
    author: "ryzenfromfire"
    repo:   "ryzenfromfire/obsidian-phoenix"
    slug:   "phoenix"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/phoenix"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/ryzenfromfire/obsidian-phoenix"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryzenfromfire/obsidian-phoenix/HEAD/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Phoenix to give Obsidian a warm, high-contrast palette of reds, oranges, yellows, greys and blacks with subtle blue and green accents. Use Live Preview for best results and favor the dark theme, which receives primary styling and updates."
}
```
